notes: v100 lets operators enter the positive physical Code Box Center measurement exactly as measured from the printed left label edge. ServoForge applies the machine-direction sign only to the label-local coder offset while preserving the established application angle. A measured +15 remains stored as +15, while the generated servo correction can internally become -15 when the selected machine direction requires it. Legacy negative workaround values are interpreted by magnitude. v99 physical machine-direction and bottle-orientation behavior is retained.
